markets.name: Sustainable Christmas Market on Sophienstraße
markets.dateText: On all Advent weekends in 2026 (November 28 and 29, as well as December 5, 6, 12, 13, 19 and 20, 2026)
markets.hoursText: Saturday from 12 noon to 8 pm, Sunday from 11 to 7 pm
markets.description: For over 25 years, this Christmas market near Hackesche Höfe has offered visitors selected goods that are organic, sustainable and fairly produced.

markets.name: Swedish Christmas Bazaar
markets.hoursText: Friday from 4 pm to 8 pm, Saturday from 12 noon to 7 pm, Sunday from 12 noon to 6 pm
markets.description: With pytt i panna, marzipan cake, elk sausage, glögg and more, the Swedish Victoria Congregation invites Berliners to get in the mood for the Christmas season together on the first weekend of Advent.

markets.name: Wein-Nachtsmarkt at Ludwig-Beck-Platz
markets.description: Once again this year, a cozy Christmas market will take place on Ludwig-Beck-Platz. A visit is particularly worthwhile for wine lovers.

markets.name: Christmas Bazaar in the Atrium of the Federal Foreign Office
markets.hoursText: Friday from 3 pm to 6 pm, Saturday from 12 noon to 6 pm
markets.description: The Christmas bazaar of the Federal Foreign Office attracts visitors with curiosities from all over the world.

markets.name: Christmas in Westend
markets.description: Every year during Advent, a Christmassy trunked animal invites you to the Christmas market in Preußenallee.

markets.name: Advent Market in Leonhardtstraße
markets.description: On the second Advent, Charlottenburg's Leonhardtstraße is transformed into a cozy Advent mile where you can browse for presents.

markets.name: Advent Market on Karl-August-Platz
markets.description: Those in search of unique Christmas presents will find what they are looking for on the first three Sundays of Advent at the arts and crafts market on Karl-August-Platz.

markets.name: Christmas Market in Zehlendorf
markets.hoursText: Monday to Thursday from 11 am to 9 pm, Friday from 12 noon to 10 pm, Saturday from 11 am to 10 pm, Sunday from 11 am to 9 pm
markets.description: For five weeks, the old center of Zehlendorf in front of the town hall is illuminated in Christmas colors.

markets.name: Rudow Christmas Mile
markets.hoursText: Saturday from 12 noon to 10 pm, Sunday from 12 noon to 8 pm
markets.description: The former Rudow Advent Mile is expected to return as the Christmas Mile in 2026.

markets.name: Christmas market on Lohmühlen Island
markets.address: Vor dem Schlesischen Tor 2, Berlin, 10997, Deutschland
markets.hoursText: Friday from 4 pm to 10 pm, Saturday and Sunday from 2 pm to 10 pm
markets.description: This year, for the first time, Freischwimmer and Ipse Ufer are organising a joint Christmas market on the banks of the Flutgraben.

markets.name: Christmas Market at the Abenteueroase
markets.description: Christmas with the Scouts: At the beginning of December, the Abenteueroase in Steglitz is transformed into a cozy Christmas market for families.

markets.name: Christmas Market on Alexanderplatz
markets.hoursText: 11 am to 10 pm, December 24 from 11 am to 2 pm
markets.description: Every year, Alexanderplatz is the perfect place to get into the Christmas spirit. In 2026, the popular market will be divided into two clearly defined areas.

markets.name: LGBTIQA Winterdays and Christmas Avenue
markets.dateText: November 7 to December 23, 2026; closed on November 15 (Remembrance Day) and November 22 (All Souls’ Day)
markets.hoursText: Monday to Thursday, 4 pm to 10 pm; Friday to Sunday, 3 pm to 10 pm
markets.description: At the LGBTQIA Winterdays and the Christmas market on Nollendorfplatz, atmospheric lighting, a varied stage program and high-quality delicacies await visitors.

markets.name: Christmas Lights at Lichtenberg City Hall
markets.description: For more than 30 years, the Lichtenberg District Office has been inviting people to enjoy the pre-Christmas season in a neighborly atmosphere on the first day of Advent.

markets.name: Sustainable Christmas Market at Schönhausen Palace
markets.hoursText: Friday from 2 pm to 9 pm, Saturday from 12 noon to 9 pm, Sunday from 12 noon to 6 pm
markets.description: The Sustainable Christmas market in Pankow takes place in a magical setting.

markets.name: Winter Market at the former Tegel Airport
markets.hoursText: Saturday from 2 pm to 10 pm, Sunday from 2 pm to 8 pm
markets.description: A winter market with a programme of events is taking place for the second time this year at the old cargo canteen of the former Tegel Airport.

markets.name: Medieval Christmas Market at the RAW Compound
markets.hoursText: Monday through Thursday from 3 pm to 10 pm, Friday from 3 pm to 11 pm, Saturday from noon to 11 pm, Sunday from noon to 10 pm; closed on November 22, 2026
markets.fee: Tuesday to Friday: 3 euros, concessions 1.50 euros; Saturday and Sunday: 4 euros, concessions 2 euros; free on Mondays; free for children under five
markets.description: This Christmas market in Friedrichshain presents itself in all its historical splendour.

markets.name: Christmas Bazaar in Britz
markets.description: The Marienfelder Weg allotment garden site attracts visitors to Britz on the second weekend of Advent with a Christmas market.

markets.name: Christmas Market at Alpinia
markets.dateText: On all Sundays in Advent 2026 (November 29, December 6, 13 and 20, 2026)
markets.description: Christmas coziness in Tempelhof: The Hotel Landhaus Alpinia is once again hosting a small but exquisite Advent market this year.

markets.name: Christmas Market in Spandau
markets.hoursText: Sunday to Thursday from 11 am to 8 pm, Friday and Saturday from 11 am to 10 pm
markets.description: In Advent, the streets and alleys in the old town of Spandau change into a beautiful Christmas world complete with market stalls and a renaissance fair.

markets.name: Advent Market at Domäne Dahlem
markets.dateText: On all weekends in Advent (November 28 and 29, December 5, 6, 12, 13, 19, and 20, 2026)
markets.description: A cozy estate atmosphere, selected stalls and a colorful program for children: the Advent market at the Domäne Dahlem has a lot to offer.

markets.name: Christmas Market to go in Kranoldkiez
markets.description: The entire Kranoldkiez neighborhood will transform itself into a decentralized Christmas market on the Saturday before the third Advent.

markets.name: Social Christmas Market at Stadtschloss Moabit
markets.description: In 2026, Goldnetz’s social Christmas market will once again take place at Moabit City Palace.

markets.name: Spandauer Winterland
markets.hoursText: Monday to Thursday from 2 pm to 9 pm, Friday and Saturday from 2 pm to 10 pm, Sunday from 12 noon to 9 pm, 27 December from 12 noon to 8 pm; closed on November 15 and 22 and on December 24, 2026
markets.description: For the second time this year, a festive winter wonderland with a carnival atmosphere is being created on the former post office grounds in Spandau.

markets.name: Advent Market in Altglienicke
markets.description: Not far from the Altglienicke S-Bahn station, a cozy Christmas atmosphere will reign when the local Advent market opens its stalls.

markets.name: Winterquartier Berlin
markets.hoursText: Saturdays and Sundays from 12 noon to 8 pm
markets.description: A new Christmas world for Berlin: Christmas fans will find everything they could wish for at the Napoleon complex with a Christmas market, ice rink, curling and a cultural program.

markets.name: Arts and Crafts Christmas Market in Gatow
markets.description: A well-rounded mix of arts and crafts, festive music and charitable causes characterizes the small and cozy Christmas market in Gatow.

markets.name: Christmas Market at the Karlshorst Racing Track
markets.description: This intercultural Christmas market takes place every year under the motto "The world at home in Karlshorst".

markets.name: Danish Christmas Market
markets.description: Christianskirkens julemarked, the Danish Christmas market on Brienner Straße, attracts visitors to Wilmersdorf with numerous Nordic specialties.

markets.name: British Christmas Market
markets.description: Under the motto "A Very British Christmas", the congregation of St George's Church in Charlottenburg organizes a cozy Christmas market every year.

markets.name: Lichtenberger Winterzeit
markets.hoursText: Monday to Thursday from 2 pm to 10 pm, Friday and Saturday from 2 pm to 11 pm, Sunday and public holidays from 2 pm to 10 pm; closed on 22 November and 24 December 2026
markets.description: The "Lichtenberger Winterzeit" Christmas fair attracts numerous guests to Lichtenberg with mulled wine and a funfair atmosphere.

markets.name: Christmas Market on Breitscheidplatz
markets.description: This Christmas market in Berlin's western center is worth a visit while shopping on famous Kurfürstendamm.

markets.name: Christmas Market on Bölschestraße
markets.hoursText: Friday from 2 pm to 10 pm, Saturday from 12 noon to 10 pm, Sunday from 12 noon to 8 pm
markets.description: During Advent, the marketplace on the Bölschestraße in Friedrichshagen is transformed into a romantic Christmas market.

markets.name: Christmas Market in Grunewald
markets.description: Since 1976, the Grunewald Christmas Market has been held on the 1st of Advent around the Grunewald Church.

markets.name: Christmas Market at the Grunewald Forestry Office
markets.description: For many Berliners, the atmospheric Christmas market at the Grunewald Forestry Office is an integral part of the pre-Christmas season.

markets.name: Arts and Crafts Christmas Market on Mexikoplatz
markets.dateText: On all Sundays in Advent 2026 (November 29, December 6, 13 and 20, 2026)
markets.description: The Christmas market on Mexikoplatz has been taking place every December for over thirty years and can therefore rightly call itself a Berlin institution.

markets.name: Christmas Market at the Grunewald Hunting Lodge
markets.description: A castle deep in the forest, brightly lit market stalls and the smell of Christmas treats... The Christmas market at Grunewald Hunting Lodge creates a festive atmosphere.

markets.name: Culinary Christmas Market in Schöneberg
markets.hoursText: 3 pm to 9 pm; closed on December 24
markets.description: Always follow your nose: One of Berlin's most delicious Christmas markets is hidden in a Schöneberg courtyard.

markets.name: Christmas Market at KaDeWe
markets.hoursText: Sunday to Thursday from 11 am to 9 pm, Friday and Saturday from 11 am to 10 pm, 24 December from 11 am to 3 pm, 25 and 26 December from 1 pm to 9 pm, 31 December from 11 am to 3 am, 1 January from 1 pm to 10 pm
markets.description: An atmospheric Christmas market takes place on Wittenbergplatz, right next to the famous KaDeWe.

markets.name: Christmas Market on Lehmann's Farm
markets.dateText: On the second and third weekends of Advent in 2026 (4 to 6 and 11 to 13 December)
markets.hoursText: Friday from 2 pm to 8 pm, Saturday and Sunday from 12 noon to 8 pm
markets.description: Cozy Christmas in the south of Berlin: On the Lehmann farm in Marienfelde, visitors can enjoy a break from the big city while strolling through the local Christmas market.

markets.name: Christmas Market at the Evangelical St. John's Foundation
markets.description: After a contemplative Advent service, the small Christmas market at the Evangelical St. John's Foundation (Evangelisches Johannesstift) in Spandau puts visitors in a festive mood.

markets.name: Christmas Market on the Dicke Linda
markets.description: Every year, the slightly sleepy Kranoldplatz in Neukölln hosts an relaxed Christmas market with charm and special offers.

markets.name: Nowkoelln Xmas Flowmarkt
markets.description: This Christmas market on Maybachufer attracts visitors with all kinds of handmade goods.

markets.name: Christmas at Tempelhof Airport
markets.description: With a festive winter market complete with activities for children, the old fire station at the THF Tower will be a cosy winter wonderland.

markets.name: Christmas Festival at the Alte Fasanerie
markets.description: The Christmas festival at the Alte Fasanerie is particularly popular with families with children and makes their eyes light up.

markets.name: Arts and Crafts Christmas Market in Frohnau
markets.description: On the second weekend of Advent, visitors can shop for unusual gift ideas in the heart of Berlin-Frohnau at the local Christmas market.

markets.name: Advent Bazaar of the Lübars Church
markets.description: On the border to Brandenburg, the Christmas market in Lübars invites you to enjoy the holiday season together with neighbors, friends and family.

markets.name: Advent Market at the Tegel Forestry Office
markets.description: With a campfire and game sales, the Advent market at the Tegel Forestry Office is a bit more rustic, but all the cozier for it.

markets.name: Advent Market in Papierstraße
markets.description: Somewhat hidden in Alt-Reinickendorf, the Advent market in Papierstraße takes place in open workshop spaces.

markets.name: Medieval Christmas Market at Britz Palace
markets.dateText: On all Advent weekends in 2026 (November 27 to 29, December 4 to 6, 11 to 13, and 18 to 20)
markets.description: The Christmas market at Gutshof Britz has a Nordic and historical influence. A fairytale program makes the eyes of children and adults alike light up.

markets.name: Weihnachtsrodeo Design Market
markets.description: During Advent, the Colosseum hosts a Christmas market with a difference. Designers present creative gift ideas in a rather unique location.

markets.name: Christmas Market on Alice-Salomon-Platz
markets.hoursText: 11 am to 9 pm, closed on December 24
markets.description: The family Christmas market in Hellersdorf will make children's eyes shine from the end of November.

markets.name: Christmas Market at Köpenick Palace
markets.hoursText: Friday from 2 pm to 10 pm, Saturday from 12 noon to 10 pm, Sunday from 12 noon to 8 pm
markets.description: Located in the old town of Berlin-Köpenick with its cobblestone alleys and Baroque palace, this Christmas market is one of the most atmospheric in Berlin.

markets.name: Christmas Market in Oberschöneweide
markets.description: The "Oberschöne Weihnachtsmarkt" takes place in a former industrial hall and attracts visitors with an entertainment program.

markets.name: Christmas Market at the Christuskirche in Oberschöneweide
markets.description: In Köpenick, the Christmas season starts early: The Christmas market in front of the church in Oberschöneweide traditionally opens its doors on the Saturday before the first Advent.

markets.name: Advent Market at Hanff's Ruh
markets.hoursText: Saturday from 12 noon to 8 pm, Sunday from 11 am to 7 pm
markets.description: Contemplative music, mulled wine and candied apples: the Advent market in Köpenick focuses on tradition and aims to awaken childhood memories.

markets.name: Solidarity Winter Market in Görlitzer Park
markets.hoursText: Saturday from 2 pm to 8 pm, Sunday from 12 noon to 6 pm
markets.description: The Solidarity Winter Market sees itself as an alternative to the many commercial Christmas markets in Berlin.

markets.name: Merry Markthalle
markets.dateText: On the last three Sundays of Advent in 2026 (6, 13 and 20 December 2026)
markets.description: Markthalle Neun is transformed into a cozy Christmas paradise during the Advent season.

markets.name: Norwegian Christmas Bazaar
markets.description: The Norwegian Church in Berlin traditionally organizes a cozy Christmas bazaar in Kreuzberg in the Advent season.

markets.name: Christmas Market in Alt-Kaulsdorf
markets.description: Every year in December, the whole neighborhood comes together for roasted almonds and mulled wine at the neighborhood Christmas market in Alt-Kaulsdorf.

markets.name: Glühwald at Uber Platz
markets.uncertainEnd: End date and closing time unconfirmed
markets.description: Uber Platz is transformed into a cozy Christmas forest during the Advent season.

markets.name: All Inclusive Christmas Market at Spreespeicher
markets.hoursText: 5 pm to 10 pm; closed from December 24 to 26, 2026
markets.fee: Between €30 and €67, depending on the time of day and the day of the week
markets.description: At this very special Christmas market near the Oberbaum Bridge, all foods and drinks are included in the market admission fee.

markets.name: Heissa Holzmarkt
markets.hoursText: Wednesday to Friday from 4 pm to 10 pm, Saturday from 12 noon to 10 pm, Sunday from 12 noon to 8 pm
markets.fee: Wednesday and Thursday: €2; Friday to Sunday: €3
markets.description: The winter market on Holzmarktstraße boasts a very special atmosphere, extraordinary foods and drinks and a diverse program for all visitors.

markets.name: Holy Shit Shopping
markets.description: During Advent, the Haus der Visionäre in Friedrichshain is transformed into a design market offering creative gift ideas.

markets.name: Christmas Market at the Berlin Animal Shelter
markets.fee: 1 euro, free for children under six
markets.description: The Berlin Animal Shelter traditionally organizes the "Christmas Festival for Animals" every year during the Advent season. The highlight is the gift-giving in the kennels and cabins.

markets.name: Christmas Market at Berlin City Hall
markets.hoursText: Monday to Friday from 12 noon to 10 pm, Saturday and Sunday from 11 am to 10 pm, closed on Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve, 3 January 2027 until 8 pm
markets.description: A market alley, an ice skating rink around the Neptune Fountain, street artists, puppeteers, storytellers and more: the Christmas market at Rotes Rathaus has a lot to offer.

markets.name: Finnish Advent Bazaar
markets.description: The Christmas traditions of the Nordic countries enjoy great popularity in December. In Kreuzberg, Christmas is celebrated the Finnish way with a bazaar at the Passionskirche on Marheinekeplatz.

markets.name: Berlin Dog Christmas Market
markets.fee: €2.50, of which €1 goes to an animal welfare organization
markets.description: Berlin loves its four-legged friends! So it is not surprising that the dogs of the capital get their own Christmas market.

markets.name: Pankow Advent Market at Heynhöfe
markets.hoursText: Saturday from 11 am to 8 pm, Sunday from 11 am to 7 pm
markets.description: For several years now, the Heynhöfe business park has been transformed into a cozy Christmas mile in December where neighborhood residents, Berliners and visitors meet.

markets.name: Advent Market on Kollwitzplatz
markets.dateText: On all Sundays in Advent 2026 (29 November, 6, 13 and 20 December 2026)
markets.description: The Advent Market on Kollwitzplatz offers gifts, goods and foods produced under fair social and eco-friendly conditions.

markets.name: Christmas Market at Charlottenburg Palace
markets.hoursText: Monday to Thursday from 1 pm to 10 pm, Friday to Sunday from 12 noon to 10 pm; closed on December 24
markets.description: With its romantic setting and magnificent illuminations, the Christmas market at Charlottenburg Palace is popular with Berliners and visitors alike for good reason.

markets.name: Christmas Market in Alt-Rixdorf
markets.hoursText: Friday from 5 to 9 pm, Saturday from 2 to 9 pm, Sunday from 2 to 8 pm
markets.description: Cobblestones, warm light from oil lamps and a historical backdrop: The Alt-Rixdorf Christmas market on Richardplatz attracts visitors with its unique ambience and charitable commitment.

markets.name: Christmas Market on Gendarmenmarkt
markets.description: Located on one of the most beautiful squares in Berlin, this Christmas Market offers quality decorations, food and entertainment.

markets.name: Christmas Market at the Humboldt Forum
markets.hoursText: 11 am to 10 pm, closed on November 22 and December 24, 2026
markets.description: In 2026, a winter market with a special ambience will once again take place on in front of Berlin Palace and in the Schlüterhof.

markets.name: Christmas Market at Späth'sche Baumschulen
markets.dateText: On the first three Advent weekends in 2026 (November 28 and 29, December 05, 06, 12, and 13)
markets.description: Extensive stage program with a visit from an angel: For years, the Christmas market at Späth'sche Baumschulen has been a winter highlight for many families.

markets.name: Lucia Christmas Market at Kulturbrauerei
markets.hoursText: Monday to Friday from 3 to 10 pm, Saturday and Sunday from 1 to 10 pm
markets.description: The Christmas market in the Kulturbrauerei attracts visitors with its contemplative atmosphere, a warm and cozy ambience and a daily cultural program.
